title: Auto-Search and Refinement: An Automated Framework for Gender Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the multiple-choice BBQ-gender benchmark using sDIS and sAMB metrics for ambiguous and disambiguated contexts, and assessing open-ended dialogue fairness on the GenderAlign test set (GA-test) using LLM-as-a-judge to compute win-tie-loss rates based on predefined fairness criteria.
